title: Prouni 2026 pre-selected candidates have deadline until Friday to verify data
subtitle: Students included in the program's second call must validate their information before the end of the week
excerpt: Pre‑selected students in Prouni 2026's second call must verify their data by Friday, as set by the program's calendar.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The University for All Program (Prouni) opened its second call for the second semester of 2026, placing students in a pre‑selection status. These candidates now have a specific deadline to verify the information submitted at the time of application.

Established deadline

According to the announcement, the deadline for data verification by the pre‑selected candidates is next Friday. Meeting this deadline is an essential condition for the application to remain in the evaluation process.

What does being pre‑selected mean?

Being pre‑selected indicates that the applicant met Prouni's initial criteria, but still needs to validate documents and personal information, such as family income, schooling situation, and other requirements demanded by the program. This step serves to confirm eligibility before the scholarship is granted.

Importance of verification

Data verification allows the Ministry of Education to check the accuracy of the information and ensure that the spots are allocated to students who truly meet Prouni's rules. Failure to submit the documents within the deadline may result in the candidate's removal from the list of beneficiaries.

Students who have not yet submitted the documentation should contact the official Prouni communication channels to learn how to proceed. General guidance includes the need to present documents such as income proof, school transcript, and other requirements required for the scholarship.

This step concludes the second call of Prouni 2026, paving the way for the confirmation of scholarships that will be distributed throughout the second semester.

With information from Agência Brasil.
